<TOOL_CALL>{"tool_id": "Unity.CodeEdit", "call_id": "6ac21219-065b-4817-8045-03c79142041f", "args": {"newString": "using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Steamworks;
using UnityEngine;

public class MarketSquareManager : MonoBehaviour
{
    public static MarketSquareManager Instance;

    public Transform worldSpawn;
    public MarketSquarePlatformTrigger platformTrigger;
    public float countdownDuration = 5f;

    private float countdownTimer = -1f;
    private bool isCountingDown = false;
    private bool matchStarting = false;

    private void Awake()
    {
        Instance = this;
        if (worldSpawn == null)
        {
            GameObject spawnObj = GameObject.Find("MarketSquareWorldSpawn");
            if (spawnObj != null)
            {
                worldSpawn = spawnObj.transform;
            }
        }
    }

    private void Start()
    {
        if (platformTrigger == null)
        {
            platformTrigger = MarketSquarePlatformTrigger.Instance;
        }

        if (SteamLobby.Instance != null && SteamLobby.Instance.currentLobby.Id.Value != 0)
        {
            SteamLobby.Instance.currentLobby.SetJoinable(true);
        }

        if (LocalClient.serverOwner)
        {
            StartCoroutine(SpawnInitialHostAndPlayersRoutine());
        }
    }

    private IEnumerator SpawnInitialHostAndPlayersRoutine()
    {
        yield return new WaitForSeconds(0.1f);

        Vector3 spawnPos = worldSpawn != null ? worldSpawn.position : Vector3.zero;

        List<Vector3> spawnList = new List<Vector3>();
        int total = Server.clients.Count;
        for (int i = 0; i < total + 5; i++)
        {
            Vector2 offset = Random.insideUnitCircle * 2f;
            spawnList.Add(spawnPos + new Vector3(offset.x, 0f, offset.y));
        }

        if (GameManager.instance != null)
        {
            GameManager.instance.SendPlayersIntoGame(spawnList);
        }
    }

    public void OnPlayerPlatformStateChanged()
    {
        if (!LocalClient.serverOwner || matchStarting)
        {
            return;
        }

        int totalInLobby = GameManager.instance != null ? GameManager.instance.GetPlayersInLobby() : 1;
        int readyCount = platformTrigger != null ? platformTrigger.playersOnPlatform.Count : 0;

        if (readyCount >= totalInLobby && totalInLobby > 0)
        {
            if (!isCountingDown)
            {
                isCountingDown = true;
                countdownTimer = countdownDuration;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            if (isCountingDown)
            {
                isCountingDown = false;
                countdownTimer = -1f;
                ServerSend.MarketSquareCountdown(-1f, readyCount, totalInLobby);
                if (MarketSquareUI.Instance != null)
                {
                    MarketSquareUI.Instance.HideCountdown();
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void Update()
    {
        if (!LocalClient.serverOwner || matchStarting)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (isCountingDown)
        {
            countdownTimer -= Time.deltaTime;
            int totalInLobby = GameManager.instance != null ? GameManager.instance.GetPlayersInLobby() : 1;
            int readyCount = platformTrigger != null ? platformTrigger.playersOnPlatform.Count : 0;

            ServerSend.MarketSquareCountdown(countdownTimer, readyCount, totalInLobby);
            if (MarketSquareUI.Instance != null)
            {
                MarketSquareUI.Instance.UpdateCountdown(countdownTimer, readyCount, totalInLobby);
            }

            if (countdownTimer <= 0f)
            {
                matchStarting = true;
                isCountingDown = false;
                StartMatchFromHub();
            }
        }
    }

    private void StartMatchFromHub()
    {
        if (SteamLobby.Instance != null && SteamLobby.Instance.currentLobby.Id.Value != 0)
        {
            SteamLobby.Instance.currentLobby.SetJoinable(false);
        }

        GameSettings settings = GameManager.gameSettings ?? new GameSettings(Random.Range(int.MinValue, int.MaxValue), GameSettings.GameMode.Survival, GameSettings.FriendlyFire.Off, GameSettings.Difficulty.Normal, GameSettings.GameLength.Short, GameSettings.Multiplayer.On);

        foreach (Client client in Server.clients.Values)
        {
            if (client?.player != null)
            {
                client.player.ready = false;
                client.player.loading = false;
                ServerSend.StartGame(client.player.id, settings);
            }
        }
    }
}

using UnityEngine;

public class MarketSquareUI : MonoBehaviour
{
    public static MarketSquareUI Instance;

    public GameObject countdownContainer;
    public TextMeshProUGUI countdownText;
    public TextMeshProUGUI readyStatusText;

    private void Awake()
    {
        Instance = this;
        if (countdownContainer != null)
        {
            countdownContainer.SetActive(false);
        }
    }

    public void UpdateCountdown(float secondsLeft, int readyCount, int totalCount)
    {
        if (countdownContainer != null)
        {
            countdownContainer.SetActive(secondsLeft > 0f);
        }

        if (countdownText != null)
        {
            int ceilSeconds = Mathf.CeilToInt(secondsLeft);
            countdownText.text = $"Starting in {ceilSeconds}...";
            float scale = 1f + (ceilSeconds - secondsLeft) * 0.15f;
            countdownText.transform.localScale = new Vector3(scale, scale, 1f);
        }

        if (readyStatusText != null)
        {
            readyStatusText.text = $"Ready: {readyCount}/{totalCount}";
        }
    }

    public void HideCountdown()
    {
        if (countdownContainer != null)
        {
            countdownContainer.SetActive(false);
        }
    }
}

    public static MarketSquarePlatformTrigger Instance;

    {
        Instance = this;
    }

    private void OnTriggerEnter(Collider other)
    {

            }

using Steamworks;
using UnityEngine;

public class MarketSquareManager : MonoBehaviour
{
    public static MarketSquareManager Instance;

    public Transform worldSpawn;
    public MarketSquarePlatformTrigger platformTrigger;
    public float countdownDuration = 5f;

    private float countdownTimer = -1f;
    private bool isCountingDown = false;
    private bool matchStarting = false;

    private void Awake()
    {
        Instance = this;
        if (worldSpawn == null)
        {
            GameObject spawnObj = GameObject.Find("MarketSquareWorldSpawn");
            if (spawnObj != null)
            {
                worldSpawn = spawnObj.transform;
            }
        }
    }

    private void Start()
    {
        if (platformTrigger == null)
        {
            platformTrigger = MarketSquarePlatformTrigger.Instance;
        }

        if (SteamLobby.Instance != null && SteamLobby.Instance.currentLobby.Id.Value != 0)
        {
            SteamLobby.Instance.currentLobby.SetJoinable(true);
        }

        if (LocalClient.serverOwner)
        {
            StartCoroutine(SpawnInitialHostAndPlayersRoutine());
        }
    }

    private IEnumerator SpawnInitialHostAndPlayersRoutine()
    {
        yield return new WaitForSeconds(0.1f);

        Vector3 spawnPos = worldSpawn != null ? worldSpawn.position : Vector3.zero;

        List<Vector3> spawnList = new List<Vector3>();
        int total = Server.clients.Count;
        for (int i = 0; i < total + 5; i++)
        {
            Vector2 offset = Random.insideUnitCircle * 2f;
            spawnList.Add(spawnPos + new Vector3(offset.x, 0f, offset.y));
        }

        if (GameManager.instance != null)
        {
            GameManager.instance.SendPlayersIntoGame(spawnList);
        }
    }

    public void OnPlayerPlatformStateChanged()
    {
        if (!LocalClient.serverOwner || matchStarting)
        {
            return;
        }

        int totalInLobby = GameManager.instance != null ? GameManager.instance.GetPlayersInLobby() : 1;
        int readyCount = platformTrigger != null ? platformTrigger.playersOnPlatform.Count : 0;

        if (readyCount >= totalInLobby && totalInLobby > 0)
        {
            if (!isCountingDown)
            {
                isCountingDown = true;
                countdownTimer = countdownDuration;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            if (isCountingDown)
            {
                isCountingDown = false;
                countdownTimer = -1f;
                ServerSend.MarketSquareCountdown(-1f, readyCount, totalInLobby);
                if (MarketSquareUI.Instance != null)
                {
                    MarketSquareUI.Instance.HideCountdown();
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void Update()
    {
        if (!LocalClient.serverOwner || matchStarting)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (isCountingDown)
        {
            countdownTimer -= Time.deltaTime;
            int totalInLobby = GameManager.instance != null ? GameManager.instance.GetPlayersInLobby() : 1;
            int readyCount = platformTrigger != null ? platformTrigger.playersOnPlatform.Count : 0;

            ServerSend.MarketSquareCountdown(countdownTimer, readyCount, totalInLobby);
            if (MarketSquareUI.Instance != null)
            {
                MarketSquareUI.Instance.UpdateCountdown(countdownTimer, readyCount, totalInLobby);
            }

            if (countdownTimer <= 0f)
            {
                matchStarting = true;
                isCountingDown = false;
                StartMatchFromHub();
            }
        }
    }

    private void StartMatchFromHub()
    {
        if (SteamLobby.Instance != null && SteamLobby.Instance.currentLobby.Id.Value != 0)
        {
            SteamLobby.Instance.currentLobby.SetJoinable(false);
        }

        GameSettings settings = GameManager.gameSettings ?? new GameSettings(Random.Range(int.MinValue, int.MaxValue), GameSettings.GameMode.Survival, GameSettings.FriendlyFire.Off, GameSettings.Difficulty.Normal, GameSettings.GameLength.Short, GameSettings.Multiplayer.On);

        foreach (Client client in Server.clients.Values)
        {
            if (client?.player != null)
            {
                client.player.ready = false;
                client.player.loading = false;
                ServerSend.StartGame(client.player.id, settings);
            }
        }
    }
}

<TOOL_CALL>{"tool_id": "Unity.CodeEdit", "call_id": "b8e7f434-89b0-480c-8e17-1de48e07b690", "args": {"expectedOccurrences": 1, "filePath": "Assets/Scripts/Assembly-CSharp/GameManager.cs", "newString": "	private void ShowEndScreen()
	{
		GameManager.state = GameManager.GameState.GameOver;
		if (this.gameoverUi != null)
		{
			this.gameoverUi.SetActive(true);
		}
		Cursor.visible = true;
		Cursor.lockState = CursorLockMode.None;
	}

	public void ReturnToMenu()
	{
		ReturnToMarketSquare();
	}

	public void ReturnToMarketSquare()
	{
		if (LocalClient.serverOwner)
		{
			if (SteamLobby.Instance != null && SteamLobby.Instance.currentLobby.Id.Value != 0)
			{
				SteamLobby.Instance.currentLobby.SetJoinable(true);
			}

			GameSettings settings = GameManager.gameSettings ?? new GameSettings(Random.Range(int.MinValue, int.MaxValue), GameSettings.GameMode.Survival, GameSettings.FriendlyFire.Off, GameSettings.Difficulty.Normal, GameSettings.GameLength.Short, GameSettings.Multiplayer.On);

			foreach (Client client in Server.clients.Values)
			{
				if (client?.player != null)
				{
					client.player.ready = false;
					client.player.loading = false;
					ServerSend.StartGame(client.player.id, settings, "MarketSquare");
				}
			}
		}
		else
		{
			// Non-host waits for host packet, or loads if singleplayer/testing
			if (!SteamManager.Instance.ConnectedToSteam())
			{
				SceneManager.LoadScene("MarketSquare");
			}
		}
	}", "oldString": "	private void ShowEndScreen()
	{
		GameManager.state = GameManager.GameState.GameOver;
		this.gameoverUi.SetActive(true);
		Cursor.visible = true;
		Cursor.lockState = CursorLockMode.None;
	}

	public void ReturnToMenu()
	{
		SceneManager.LoadScene("TestSteamLobby");
	}", "description": "Update ReturnToMenu to return party to MarketSquare hub"}, "agent": "CoreAgent"}</TOOL_CALL>

<TOOL_CALL>{"tool_id": "Unity.CodeEdit", "call_id": "6ac21219-065b-4817-8045-03c79142041f", "args": {"newString": "using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Steamworks;
using UnityEngine;

public class MarketSquareManager : MonoBehaviour
{
    public static MarketSquareManager Instance;

    public Transform worldSpawn;
    public MarketSquarePlatformTrigger platformTrigger;
    public float countdownDuration = 5f;

    private float countdownTimer = -1f;
    private bool isCountingDown = false;
    private bool matchStarting = false;

    private void Awake()
    {
        Instance = this;
        if (worldSpawn == null)
        {
            GameObject spawnObj = GameObject.Find("MarketSquareWorldSpawn");
            if (spawnObj != null)
            {
                worldSpawn = spawnObj.transform;
            }
        }
    }

    private void Start()
    {
        if (platformTrigger == null)
        {
            platformTrigger = MarketSquarePlatformTrigger.Instance;
        }

        if (SteamLobby.Instance != null && SteamLobby.Instance.currentLobby.Id.Value != 0)
        {
            SteamLobby.Instance.currentLobby.SetJoinable(true);
        }

        if (LocalClient.serverOwner)
        {
            StartCoroutine(SpawnInitialHostAndPlayersRoutine());
        }
    }

    private IEnumerator SpawnInitialHostAndPlayersRoutine()
    {
        yield return new WaitForSeconds(0.1f);

        Vector3 spawnPos = worldSpawn != null ? worldSpawn.position : Vector3.zero;

        List<Vector3> spawnList = new List<Vector3>();
        int total = Server.clients.Count;
        for (int i = 0; i < total + 5; i++)
        {
            Vector2 offset = Random.insideUnitCircle * 2f;
            spawnList.Add(spawnPos + new Vector3(offset.x, 0f, offset.y));
        }

        if (GameManager.instance != null)
        {
            GameManager.instance.SendPlayersIntoGame(spawnList);
        }
    }

    public void OnPlayerPlatformStateChanged()
    {
        if (!LocalClient.serverOwner || matchStarting)
        {
            return;
        }

        int totalInLobby = GameManager.instance != null ? GameManager.instance.GetPlayersInLobby() : 1;
        int readyCount = platformTrigger != null ? platformTrigger.playersOnPlatform.Count : 0;

        if (readyCount >= totalInLobby && totalInLobby > 0)
        {
            if (!isCountingDown)
            {
                isCountingDown = true;
                countdownTimer = countdownDuration;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            if (isCountingDown)
            {
                isCountingDown = false;
                countdownTimer = -1f;
                ServerSend.MarketSquareCountdown(-1f, readyCount, totalInLobby);
                if (MarketSquareUI.Instance != null)
                {
                    MarketSquareUI.Instance.HideCountdown();
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void Update()
    {
        if (!LocalClient.serverOwner || matchStarting)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (isCountingDown)
        {
            countdownTimer -= Time.deltaTime;
            int totalInLobby = GameManager.instance != null ? GameManager.instance.GetPlayersInLobby() : 1;
            int readyCount = platformTrigger != null ? platformTrigger.playersOnPlatform.Count : 0;

            ServerSend.MarketSquareCountdown(countdownTimer, readyCount, totalInLobby);
            if (MarketSquareUI.Instance != null)
            {
                MarketSquareUI.Instance.UpdateCountdown(countdownTimer, readyCount, totalInLobby);
            }

            if (countdownTimer <= 0f)
            {
                matchStarting = true;
                isCountingDown = false;
                StartMatchFromHub();
            }
        }
    }

    private void StartMatchFromHub()
    {
        if (SteamLobby.Instance != null && SteamLobby.Instance.currentLobby.Id.Value != 0)
        {
            SteamLobby.Instance.currentLobby.SetJoinable(false);
        }

        GameSettings settings = GameManager.gameSettings ?? new GameSettings(Random.Range(int.MinValue, int.MaxValue), GameSettings.GameMode.Survival, GameSettings.FriendlyFire.Off, GameSettings.Difficulty.Normal, GameSettings.GameLength.Short, GameSettings.Multiplayer.On);

        foreach (Client client in Server.clients.Values)
        {
            if (client?.player != null)
            {
                client.player.ready = false;
                client.player.loading = false;
                ServerSend.StartGame(client.player.id, settings);
            }
        }
    }
}

<TOOL_CALL>{"tool_id": "Unity.RunCommand", "call_id": "6b9b3cdf-6a13-40fe-b864-1a2e510102fb", "args": {"code": "using UnityEngine;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.SceneManagement;
using UnityEngine.UI;
using TMPro;

internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand
{
    public void Execute(ExecutionResult result)
    {
        var marketScene = EditorSceneManager.OpenScene("Assets/Scene/Scenes/MarketSquare.unity", OpenSceneMode.Single);

        // 1. Setup WorldStartPlatform trigger
        var platformObj = GameObject.Find("WorldStartPlatform");
        if (platformObj != null)
        {
            var trigger = platformObj.GetComponent<MarketSquarePlatformTrigger>();
            if (trigger == null)
            {
                trigger = platformObj.AddComponent<MarketSquarePlatformTrigger>();
                result.RegisterObjectCreation(trigger);
            }
            
            // Ensure there is a trigger collider on the platform
            var boxCol = platformObj.GetComponent<BoxCollider>();
            if (boxCol != null)
            {
                // Let's add a trigger collider if only solid exists
                var colliders = platformObj.GetComponents<BoxCollider>();
                BoxCollider trigCol = null;
                foreach (var c in colliders)
                {
                    if (c.isTrigger) trigCol = c;
                }
                if (trigCol == null)
                {
                    trigCol = platformObj.AddComponent<BoxCollider>();
                    trigCol.isTrigger = true;
                    // Make trigger slightly higher to easily catch players walking on it
                    trigCol.center = boxCol.center + new Vector3(0, 1.5f, 0);
                    trigCol.size = boxCol.size + new Vector3(0, 3f, 0);
                    result.RegisterObjectCreation(trigCol);
                }
            }
            result.Log("Configured WorldStartPlatform trigger");
        }

        // 2. Setup MarketSquareManager
        var mgrs = GameObject.Find("===Managers===");
        if (mgrs != null)
        {
            var msm = mgrs.GetComponent<MarketSquareManager>();
            if (msm == null)
            {
                msm = mgrs.AddComponent<MarketSquareManager>();
                result.RegisterObjectCreation(msm);
            }
            var spawnObj = GameObject.Find("MarketSquareWorldSpawn");
            if (spawnObj != null)
            {
                msm.worldSpawn = spawnObj.transform;
            }
            if (platformObj != null)
            {
                msm.platformTrigger = platformObj.GetComponent<MarketSquarePlatformTrigger>();
            }
            result.Log("Configured MarketSquareManager on ===Managers===");
        }

        // 3. Copy UI (1) from GameAfterLobby if not in MarketSquare
        var existingUI = GameObject.Find("UI (1)");
        if (existingUI == null)
        {
            var gameScene = EditorSceneManager.OpenScene("Assets/Scene/Scenes/GameAfterLobby.unity", OpenSceneMode.Additive);
            var srcUI = GameObject.Find("UI (1)");
            if (srcUI != null)
            {
                var clonedUI = Object.Instantiate(srcUI);
                clonedUI.name = "UI (1)";
                SceneManager.MoveGameObjectToScene(clonedUI, marketScene);
                result.RegisterObjectCreation(clonedUI);
                result.Log("Cloned UI (1) into MarketSquare");
            }
            EditorSceneManager.CloseScene(gameScene, true);
        }

        // 4. Add MarketSquareUI countdown overlay to UI (1)
        var uiCanvas = GameObject.Find("UI (1)");
        if (uiCanvas != null)
        {
            var existingMSUI = uiCanvas.GetComponent<MarketSquareUI>();
            if (existingMSUI == null)
            {
                existingMSUI = uiCanvas.AddComponent<MarketSquareUI>();
                result.RegisterObjectCreation(existingMSUI);
            }

            Transform containerTransform = uiCanvas.transform.Find("CountdownContainer");
            GameObject countdownContainer;
            if (containerTransform == null)
            {
                countdownContainer = new GameObject("CountdownContainer", typeof(RectTransform));
                countdownContainer.transform.SetParent(uiCanvas.transform, false);
                result.RegisterObjectCreation(countdownContainer);

                var rt = countdownContainer.GetComponent<RectTransform>();
                rt.anchorMin = new Vector2(0.5f, 1f);
                rt.anchorMax = new Vector2(0.5f, 1f);
                rt.pivot = new Vector2(0.5f, 1f);
                rt.anchoredPosition = new Vector2(0, -40);
                rt.sizeDelta = new Vector2(500, 120);

                var countTextObj = new GameObject("CountdownText", typeof(RectTransform), typeof(TextMeshProUGUI));
                countTextObj.transform.SetParent(countdownContainer.transform, false);
                result.RegisterObjectCreation(countTextObj);

                var countTMP = countTextObj.GetComponent<TextMeshProUGUI>();
                countTMP.text = "Starting in 5...";
                countTMP.fontSize = 42;
                countTMP.alignment = TextAlignmentOptions.Center;
                countTMP.color = new Color(1f, 0.85f, 0.2f, 1f);
                countTMP.fontStyle = FontStyles.Bold;

                var countRT = countTextObj.GetComponent<RectTransform>();
                countRT.anchorMin = new Vector2(0f, 0.4f);
                countRT.anchorMax = new Vector2(1f, 1f);
                countRT.offsetMin = Vector2.zero;
                countRT.offsetMax = Vector2.zero;

                var statusTextObj = new GameObject("StatusText", typeof(RectTransform), typeof(TextMeshProUGUI));
                statusTextObj.transform.SetParent(countdownContainer.transform, false);
                result.RegisterObjectCreation(statusTextObj);

                var statusTMP = statusTextObj.GetComponent<TextMeshProUGUI>();
                statusTMP.text = "All players on platform";
                statusTMP.fontSize = 24;
                statusTMP.alignment = TextAlignmentOptions.Center;
                statusTMP.color = Color.white;

                var statusRT = statusTextObj.GetComponent<RectTransform>();
                statusRT.anchorMin = new Vector2(0f, 0f);
                statusRT.anchorMax = new Vector2(1f, 0.4f);
                statusRT.offsetMin = Vector2.zero;
                statusRT.offsetMax = Vector2.zero;

                existingMSUI.countdownContainer = countdownContainer;
                existingMSUI.countdownText = countTMP;
                existingMSUI.readyStatusText = statusTMP;
                countdownContainer.SetActive(false);
                result.Log("Created Countdown HUD in MarketSquare Canvas");
            }
        }

        EditorSceneManager.SaveScene(marketScene);
        result.Log("MarketSquare scene saved successfully!");
    }
}

    private string LayerMaskToString(int mask)
    {
        var layers = new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();

    {
        var marketScene = EditorSceneManager.OpenScene("Assets/Scene/Scenes/MarketSquare.unity", OpenSceneMode.Single);

        int groundLayer = LayerMask.NameToLayer("Ground");
        int objectLayer = LayerMask.NameToLayer("Object");

        // 1. MarketGround setup
        var ground = GameObject.Find("MarketGround");
        if (ground != null)
        {
            ground.layer = groundLayer;
            
            // Remove existing mesh collider if any or keep it and add a solid thick BoxCollider
            var mc = ground.GetComponent<MeshCollider>();
            if (mc != null)
            {
                Object.DestroyImmediate(mc);
            }
            
            var bc = ground.GetComponent<BoxCollider>();
            if (bc == null)

                bc = ground.AddComponent<BoxCollider>();
                result.RegisterObjectCreation(bc);

            bc.size = new Vector3(10f, 4f, 10f);
            
            result.RegisterObjectModification(ground);
            result.Log("Updated MarketGround layer to Ground (9) and added thick BoxCollider: center {0}, size {1}", bc.center, bc.size);

        // 2. Cylinder spawn pad

            cyl.layer = groundLayer;
            result.RegisterObjectModification(cyl);
            result.Log("Updated Cylinder layer to Ground (9)");
        }

        {
            platform.layer = groundLayer;
            result.RegisterObjectModification(platform);
            result.Log("Updated WorldStartPlatform layer to Ground (9)");
        }

        // 4. Adjust MarketSquareWorldSpawn height so players spawn safely standing on ground
        var spawn = GameObject.Find("MarketSquareWorldSpawn");

        if (tavern != null)

                }

}

        foreach (var b in buttons)

            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
            {
                result.Log("  onClick[{0}]: Target={1}, Method={2}",
                    i, b.onClick.GetPersistentTarget(i), b.onClick.GetPersistentMethodName(i));
            }
        }
    }

    void PrintHierarchy(Transform t, int depth, ExecutionResult result)

        string info = $"{indent}- {t.gameObject.name} (active: {t.gameObject.activeSelf})";
        if (txt != null) info += $" [TMP: '{txt.text}']";
        if (btn != null) info += " [Button]";
        result.Log(info);
        for (int i = 0; i < t.childCount; i++)
        {
            PrintHierarchy(t.GetChild(i), depth + 1, result);
        }
    }
}

<TOOL_CALL>{"tool_id": "Unity.RunCommand", "call_id": "93ad1bfc-e0be-4480-bf90-6824a9ece55b", "args": {"title": "Update GameoverUi button text and onClick in scenes", "code": "using UnityEngine;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.SceneManagement;
using TMPro;
using UnityEngine.UI;
using UnityEditor.Events;
using UnityEngine.Events;

internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand
{
    public void Execute(ExecutionResult result)
    {
        string[] scenes = new string[] {
            "Assets/Scene/Scenes/GameAfterLobby.unity",
            "Assets/Scene/Scenes/MarketSquare.unity"
        };

        foreach (var scenePath in scenes)
        {
            var scene = EditorSceneManager.OpenScene(scenePath, OpenSceneMode.Single);
            var roots = scene.GetRootGameObjects();
            
            GameManager gm = null;
            foreach (var r in roots)
            {
                gm = r.GetComponentInChildren<GameManager>(true);
                if (gm != null) break;
            }

            foreach (var r in roots)
            {
                var goUi = FindDeepChild(r.transform, "GameoverUi");
                if (goUi != null)
                {
                    var btn = goUi.GetComponentInChildren<Button>(true);
                    if (btn != null)
                    {
                        var tmp = btn.GetComponentInChildren<TextMeshProUGUI>(true);
                        if (tmp != null)
                        {
                            result.RegisterObjectModification(tmp);
                            tmp.text = "Lobby";
                            EditorUtility.SetDirty(tmp);
                            result.Log("Updated TMP text to 'Lobby' in {0}", scenePath);
                        }

                        if (gm != null)
                        {
                            result.RegisterObjectModification(btn);
                            
                            // Clear and set onClick to gm.ReturnToMarketSquare
                            while (btn.onClick.GetPersistentEventCount() > 0)
                            {
                                UnityEventTools.RemovePersistentListener(btn.onClick, 0);
                            }
                            
                            UnityAction action = new UnityAction(gm.ReturnToMarketSquare);
                            UnityEventTools.AddPersistentListener(btn.onClick, action);
                            
                            EditorUtility.SetDirty(btn);
                            result.Log("Wired button onClick to GameManager.ReturnToMarketSquare in {0}", scenePath);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            EditorSceneManager.MarkSceneDirty(scene);
            EditorSceneManager.SaveScene(scene);
            result.Log("Saved scene {0}", scenePath);
        }
    }

    Transform FindDeepChild(Transform parent, string name)
    {
        if (parent.name == name) return parent;
        for (int i = 0; i < parent.childCount; i++)
        {
            var res = FindDeepChild(parent.GetChild(i), name);
            if (res != null) return res;
        }
        return null;
    }
}

    public BoxCollider triggerCollider;

    {
        Instance = this;

    }

    {
        if (triggerCollider == null)

            BoxCollider[] colliders = GetComponents<BoxCollider>();

            FindTriggerCollider();
            if (triggerCollider == null) return;

                ClientSend.MarketSquarePlatform(true);

            }
            else if (!isInside && playersOnPlatform.Contains(myId))

                playersOnPlatform.Remove(myId);

        }

                MarketSquareManager.Instance.OnPlayerPlatformStateChanged();
            }
        }
    }

        {
            BoxCollider[] colliders = GetComponents<BoxCollider>();

                if (col.isTrigger)
                {

                playersOnPlatform.Add(myId);
                ClientSend.MarketSquarePlatform(true);

            }
            else if (!isInside && playersOnPlatform.Contains(myId))

                playersOnPlatform.Remove(myId);

        {
            MarketSquareManager.Instance.OnPlayerPlatformStateChanged();
        }

        if (playersOnPlatform.Remove(id))

            {
                MarketSquareManager.Instance.OnPlayerPlatformStateChanged();
            }
        }
    }

    }

            BoxCollider[] colliders = GetComponents<BoxCollider>();
            foreach (var col in colliders)
            {
                if (col.isTrigger)
                {
                    triggerCollider = col;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    {
        if (triggerCollider == null)
        {
            FindTriggerCollider();
            if (triggerCollider == null) return;

            {
                playersOnPlatform.Add(myId);
                ClientSend.MarketSquarePlatform(true);
                stateChanged = true;
            }
            else if (!isInside && playersOnPlatform.Contains(myId))
            {
                playersOnPlatform.Remove(myId);
                ClientSend.MarketSquarePlatform(false);
                stateChanged = true;
            }
        }

        if (LocalClient.serverOwner && stateChanged && MarketSquareManager.Instance != null)
        {
            MarketSquareManager.Instance.OnPlayerPlatformStateChanged();
        }
    }
